# Milestone 1 – SDTM Domain Inventory

## Objective

The goal of this milestone was to become familiar with the structure of an SDTM submission package before performing any clinical programming analyses. Rather than memorizing SDTM domains, I explored the sponsor-provided datasets and metadata to understand the purpose of each domain, how the domains are organized, and what each record represents.

---

## Study

**Sponsor:** Sanofi

**Study:** EFC10261

**Therapeutic Area:** Oncology (Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer)

---

## Work Completed

During this milestone I:

- Imported all SDTM datasets into R.
- Created an automated inventory of every SDTM domain.
- Calculated the number of records and variables for each dataset.
- Classified each domain according to the SDTM General Observation Model (Findings, Events, Interventions, and Special Purpose).
- Identified the observational unit represented by each domain.
- Reviewed sponsor-defined domains using the study metadata and variable definitions rather than relying only on standard SDTM documentation.
- Distinguished subject-level domains from trial design domains.

---

## Deliverables

- `scripts/01_sdtm_inventory.R`
- `output/tables/sdtm_inventory.csv`

---

## Skills Demonstrated

- R programming
- SDTM data exploration
- Clinical trial data review
- SDTM domain classification
- Understanding of the SDTM General Observation Model
- Identification of observational units
- Working with sponsor-defined domains
- Clinical data documentation

---

## Key Takeaways

This milestone strengthened my understanding of how SDTM datasets are organized within a clinical trial submission package. By examining both the dataset structure and sponsor metadata, I learned to identify the purpose of unfamiliar domains, distinguish trial design datasets from subject-level datasets, and determine the observational unit represented by each record. These concepts provide the foundation for subject-level data review and analysis in subsequent milestones.

---

## Next Milestone

The next phase of this project will follow an individual subject through multiple SDTM domains (DM, SV, EX, AE, LB, VS, and others) to reconstruct the subject's clinical journey and better understand how information is linked across the study.
